title: Community builders brought stories, Minecraft and moral dilemmas
summary:
Five community apps joined the catalog, JavaScript arrived in Computer MCP, and decisions gained a second API path.

Five apps joined the catalog: Echo Island turns character ideas into illustrated stories and voice notes; PolliCraft and PollinationsCraft bring Pollinations to Minecraft servers; and Switchyard and Trolley Match let players compare trolley-dilemma choices with Jev. Six more community model publishers were added, and model and agent creation screens now explain that changes can take a minute or two to become callable.

Computer MCP added a JavaScript tool that can use persistent files and return a JSON-encoded result. The API added `/v1/systemone` as an alias for TypeSafe decisions on `/alpha/decisions`, with documentation for its request and response. OAuth clients can now discover supported scopes, and the API reference explains how to submit and poll asynchronous media jobs.

A new SDK agent skill guides JavaScript app setup, while the homepage can return a short Markdown summary to agents that request it. Polli CLI now configures OpenCode through a native provider compatible with 1.x and 2.0, preserves unedited symlinked configs on rollback, and keeps nested sections in filtered docs. Agent failures now identify the MCP server or deployment error more clearly; related guides were also updated.

highlights.title: Stories from Echo Island
highlights.text: Turn a character idea into an illustrated story and voice note. [Try it](https://huggingface.co/spaces/xiaotian1171/echo-island-pollinations-space).

highlights.title: Trolley dilemmas in Switchyard
highlights.text: Make your choices, compare them with Jev, then see what changes when the descriptions switch order. [Try it](https://saauf.github.io/switchyard).

highlights.title: JavaScript in Computer MCP
highlights.text: Agents can run JavaScript alongside bash, work with persistent files, and return structured results. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: A System One API path
highlights.text: Send TypeSafe decision requests to `/v1/systemone` using the same request and response shape as `/alpha/decisions`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: An SDK skill for agents
highlights.text: Agents writing JavaScript apps can find a dedicated `@pollinations/sdk` quickstart for generating text and images. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).
